rv.q: Most people are completely overwhelmed and amazed when they leave.
Do not miss Spellbound. It plays at the SoHo Playhouse through September 6th, so you have two more performances to catch her.

cn.t: Mentalist Suhani Shah amazes audiences with seemingly effortless mind-reading that leaves most viewers overwhelmed and delighted, even if the experience can feel a bit uncomfortable at times.
